summary: Caller claims to be Microsoft and says the user's computer has been flagged for malware. Asks the user to install a remote-control tool and log into their banking site while they watch — textbook remote-session hijack.
recommended_actions: Never let anyone install remote-access software on your machine
Call Microsoft directly on 1-800 numbers from their official site
Run your own antivirus update locally

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello, this is the Microsoft security team. Your computer was flagged for critical malware.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm sorry? I don't know about that.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I need you to install the teamviewer app I'm sending you, and log into your email so I can show you the problem live.
